nuclear medicine has a very important role in paediatric nephrourology.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
nuclear medicine has a key role in the diagnosis and management of children with genito-urological disorders.

the use of nuclear medicine in paediatric nephrourology should be guided by clinical need and that nuclear medicine should be used in conjunction with other imaging modalities to provide the best patient care.

the functional imaging of the kidneys and the urinary tract in paediatrics is an essential tool in the assessment and management of patients with congenital anomalies, renal calculi, renovascular hypertension and genito-urinay malignancies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
functional imaging is an integral component in the assessment of children with renal disease.
the functional information that can be obtained with nuclear imaging techniques can be very useful in the management of children with genito- urinary conditions.
functional imaging should always be performed in conjunction with anatomical imaging, as the two modalities are complementary and not interchangeable.
